item.content:encoded:
RedirHub’s WordPress plugin lets a site manage redirects, short links and 404 monitoring from RedirHub without changing DNS. We’re looking for someone who knows how WordPress plugins grow.

This is a side project: 5-8 hours a week, async, no fixed meetings. Full-time employees doing it on the side are welcome.

What you’ll do

  • Make our plugin-directory listing work: copy, screenshots, reviews, support-forum replies
  • Get the plugin in front of WordPress users and agencies: communities, newsletters, WordCamps, agency partners
  • Turn free users into paying ones: in-plugin upgrade prompts, onboarding emails, agency licenses

Pay

$40-60/hour depending on experience, up to 8 hours a week (roughly $1,200-2,000 a month), plus bonuses for active-install growth and paid upgrades you drive. Bonus amounts agreed on a first call.

You

  • Have grown a WordPress plugin before, with numbers we can check on WordPress.org
  • Know the WordPress community: WordCamps, groups, newsletters, agencies
  • Have run free-to-paid for a plugin or WordPress product

To apply (via the link), please answer:

  1. Link the plugin(s) you grew, with active installs when you started and when you left.
  2. Roughly how many hours a week you can give.
  3. Does your current employer sell a redirect, SEO or 404 product? (So we can avoid a conflict.)

The ideal candidate will have hands-on […]
item.content:encoded:
Brainstorm Force is a product-based software company that builds WordPress products and SaaS applications, while also hosting WordPress production sites for customers. We are looking for a skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer with 2–3 years of experience to help maintain the performance, security, availability, and scalability of our infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing customer hosting environments on cPanel, WordPress/PHP servers running on Nginx and LiteSpeed, and Laravel and Next.js SaaS applications deployed on bare-metal servers and VPS environments. You will also leverage AI tools like Claude in your day-to-day work to troubleshoot issues, build automation, and document solutions more efficiently, while ensuring that every production change is reliable, secure, and well-tested.

Join Our Team and Enjoy Amazing Perks:

  • Remote work
  • Flexible working hours
  • Competitive pay
  • Paid time off
  • Allowances for setting up workspace
  • Excellent work-life balance
  • Career growth opportunities

What you will be doing:

WordPress/PHP servers:

  • Run and tune Nginx + PHP-FPM and LiteSpeed/OpenLiteSpeed stacks with MySQL/MariaDB and Redis.
  • Fix slow sites, 5xx errors, memory exhaustion and database bottlenecks.

SaaS infrastructure:

  • Deploy and maintain Laravel (queues, Horizon/Supervisor, schedulers) and Next.js (Node/PM2) apps on bare metal and VPS.
  • Run zero-downtime deployments with clear rollback plans.

Customer hosting (cPanel/WHM):

  • Maintain the servers that host our customers’ production WordPress sites.
  • Handle account setup and migrations, PHP version management, resource limits, malware cleanup and email deliverability.
  • Diagnose and fix server-level issues on customer sites.

Edge and networking:

  • Own DNS, Cloudflare (WAF, caching rules, SSL modes), CDN setup and load balancing across our services.
  • Improve performance through CDN and caching (Cloudflare, server-side caching, Redis object cache).

Cloud services and reliability:

  • Manage AWS S3 storage, SES email sending and IAM access, following least-privilege practices.
  • Run monitoring, alerting, backups with tested restores, patching, SSH hardening, firewalls and SSL/TLS certificates.
  • Respond to incidents and write clear root-cause reports.
  • Document infrastructure and fixes so the team can work from shared runbooks, and work with development teams to scale applications and improve performance.

AI-assisted operations:

  • Use Claude to troubleshoot, write scripts and Ansible playbooks, review configs and keep runbooks current.
  • Automate routine tasks with shell scripting, Ansible and other tools.
  • Check AI output before running it, and never share customer data or credentials with it.

You must have these skills:

  • 2–3 years working on Linux production servers over SSH.
  • Hosted and maintained WordPress/PHP sites at server level: reading logs, fixing 500/502 errors, slow sites, PHP and memory issues.
  • Working knowledge of DNS, Cloudflare/CDN, SSL, and the basics of how load balancing works.
  • MySQL/MariaDB basics: backups, restores, finding slow queries.
  • Redis working knowledge: installing and securing it (no public exposure, password/ACL), WordPress object caching, Laravel cache/queue/session use, and basic memory and eviction settings.
  • Working knowledge of core AWS services:
    • S3: buckets, access policies, storing backups and assets, lifecycle rules
    • SES: domain verification, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, handling bounces and complaints, leaving the sandbox
    • IAM: users vs. roles, least-privilege policies, access keys and why to avoid long-lived ones
  • Uses Claude or similar AI tools in daily technical work, and checks the output before running it.

Good-to-Have skills:

  • cPanel/WHM server administration or shared-hosting infrastructure experience
  • LiteSpeed/OpenLiteSpeed, PHP-FPM tuning
  • Deploying Laravel or Node.js/Next.js apps; PM2/Supervisor
  • Load balancer setup (Nginx, HAProxy, cloud LB)
  • AWS CloudFront and other AWS services (EC2, Route 53, CloudWatch)
  • Bash scripting, Ansible, Docker, CI/CD

Ready for an exciting journey? Apply now and be part of our awesome team! We’re excited to hear from you!

If you have any questions, just email us at join@nullbsf.io.

We primarily work with small businesses, nonprofits, municipalities, and community organizations, helping them build and maintain affordable, reliable websites. As Lazy Dog Digital continues to grow, I’m looking to connect with an experienced WordPress […]
item.content:encoded:
Hi everyone!

I’m Liam, the founder of Lazy Dog Digital, a small, growing web design and hosting business based in Vermont.

We primarily work with small businesses, nonprofits, municipalities, and community organizations, helping them build and maintain affordable, reliable websites.

As Lazy Dog Digital continues to grow, I’m looking to connect with an experienced WordPress developer interested in helping out on a part-time, flexible basis.

What I’m looking for:

  • Experience building and maintaining WordPress websites
  • Familiarity with Elementor and customizations
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript
  • Someone comfortable working independently and communicating directly
  • A genuine interest in helping smaller organizations succeed

Initially, this would be part-time, project-based contract work, with hours depending on client needs and available projects.

I’m also open to finding someone interested in building a longer-term working relationship and potentially taking on a larger role as the business grows.

A little about us: Lazy Dog Digital isn’t trying to become a massive agency. My goal is to build a sustainable, approachable business that values quality work, affordability, and personal relationships with clients.

If this sounds interesting, feel free to send me a message with a little about yourself, your experience, and examples of your work.

I’d love to connect!

item.dc:creator: jobposter
item.description: Please note: This role requires very good German, as you’ll support German-speaking customers by phone, email and chat. We do not offer fully remote positions. About us HostPress is a managed WordPress hosting company based in Eppelborn, Germany. Our small, friendly team looks after the WordPress websites of more than 5,000 customers. We value how […]
item.content:encoded:
Please note: This role requires very good German, as you’ll support German-speaking customers by phone, email and chat. We do not offer fully remote positions.

About us

HostPress is a managed WordPress hosting company based in Eppelborn, Germany. Our small, friendly team looks after the WordPress websites of more than 5,000 customers. We value how we treat each other and our customers just as much as the technology. Ask when you’re stuck, help each other out, and have a laugh together. Nobody expects you to know everything on day one.

What you’ll do

  • Help customers by phone, email and chat, explaining technical topics clearly and on equal footing
  • Find and fix issues on WordPress websites, mostly through user-friendly interfaces such as Plesk rather than the command line
  • Document solutions for our help center
  • Support website migrations to HostPress, help with domains and DNS, and onboard new customers

What matters to us

  • You enjoy working with people and stay friendly even when things get busy
  • You can explain things clearly, including to people without a technical background
  • You enjoy technology and like learning new things
  • You work in a structured way and like to get things done
  • You speak very good German

Nice to have (not required):

Basic Linux knowledge, WordPress, domains & DNS, Plesk, support experience

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. You’ll learn the technical side step by step during a 6-month onboarding, with colleagues at your side.

What we offer

  • €33,000 – €45,000 gross per year
  • 6 months of real onboarding with dedicated contacts in the team
  • Supportive team, flat hierarchies
  • Apple MacBook Air, also for private use
  • Flexible working hours and a family-friendly environment
  • Hybrid work with two home-office days per week
  • 28 days of vacation plus the option to work from abroad (workation)
  • €50 tax-free per month on your company credit card

How to apply

No cover letter needed. Your name, email and a few sentences about yourself are enough; a CV is welcome but optional. Your application goes directly to our managing director Marcus Krämer, is treated confidentially, and he’ll get back to you personally.

item.description: Marc Gratch Consulting is bidding as prime on a public-agency WordPress project: the Sacramento Housing and Redevelopment Agency’s RFP 2621-KP, “SHRA Website Accessibility, Hosting, and WordPress Support.” Proposals are due November 30, 2026. We’re looking for subcontractors for two pieces of the work, and we especially want to hear from Minority- and Women-Owned Business Enterprises […]
item.content:encoded:
Marc Gratch Consulting is bidding as prime on a public-agency WordPress project: the Sacramento Housing and Redevelopment Agency’s RFP 2621-KP, “SHRA Website Accessibility, Hosting, and WordPress Support.” Proposals are due November 30, 2026.

We’re looking for subcontractors for two pieces of the work, and we especially want to hear from Minority- and Women-Owned Business Enterprises (M/WBE).

1. Document remediation. Tagging and fixing PDFs and Microsoft Office files to WCAG 2.1 AA and PDF/UA. We estimate 1,000 to 2,000 pages between January and April 2027, mostly short notices, guides and fillable forms linked from a WordPress site.

2. Independent accessibility re-audit. A yearly WCAG 2.1 AA review of the WordPress site by someone who isn’t on the team maintaining it.

All work is remote. You can quote on either piece or both.

To be considered, email by November 23, 2026 with:

  • Your pricing: per page for standard documents, and for forms or complex tables; per audit for the re-audit
  • Typical turnaround
  • The tools and testing methods you use
  • One or two examples of similar work
  • Your M/WBE certification, if you hold one

Questions are welcome at the same address.

Marc Gratch
Marc Gratch Consulting

You will join an ongoing and expanding team of sales enthusiasts who work collaboratively with all areas of the company […]
item.content:encoded:
Will you be our newest WordPress Sales Support Specialist?

We are looking for a WordPress Sales Support Specialist to promote high-quality WordPress plugins and themes that contribute to the overall success of WPMU DEV products.

You will join an ongoing and expanding team of sales enthusiasts who work collaboratively with all areas of the company to make sure we stand out from the rest!

The person we’re in search of will have intimate knowledge of WordPress and experience using a broad range of plugins and themes and will manage Accounts and Sales-related communications.

We’re looking for a person who will be able to also work on weekends and is available to work on the following schedules:

  • 10:00 pm – 6:00 am UTC
  • 3:00 pm – 11:00 pm UTC

Responsibilities

  • Leads generation
  • Providing support to customers and members by identifying solutions to their WP-related concerns through our communication channels (email, chat)
  • Providing customer service and managing customer accounts
  • Providing product knowledge and promoting WPMU DEV products.
  • Maintaining meticulous CRM hygiene while monitoring and nurturing sales leads through consistent follow-up email correspondence.
  • Managing inbound and outbound sales communications.
  • Conducting Zoom calls with potential and existing clients.

Qualifications

Essential attributes and experience required:

  • Have a really good familiarity with WordPress, including themes and plugins
  • Superb interpersonal skills, including the power to swiftly build rapport with current customers
  • Proven experience in sales and accounts and billing support
  • At least 1-year of experience in any Sales Support position
  • Proficient in English: Verbal and Written
  • Proficient in spreadsheets and data entry
  • Enjoy collaborating with others, and don’t back down from a challenge
  • Typing skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Love people and love yourself!

We like all staff to be working 40 hours a week, but if you did want to work more hours, that’s also cool with us.

SKILL-SET
WordPress, Customer Support, English language, Communication, Sales, Data entry, Google Sheets

Job benefits

Why Join us?

  • Growth-oriented culture.
  • Excellent compensation with competitive benefits and rejuvenation time-off.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Training, tools and support will be provided to help you to perform your job.
  • Limitless learning opportunities by working with cutting-edge tech stacks and a diverse, talented team.
  • 28 days of paid leave per annum (up to 35 days).
  • Opportunities for paid travel to attend WordCamps and other industry conferences.
  • Long service leaves (3 months off paid) after you’ve been with us for 10 years.
  • Annual bonus based on company growth targets
  • Technology budget that can help you upgrade the tools you use for your job; the longer you serve, the higher the budget.
  • General expenses budget yearly that can be used to help you become more productive; the longer you work, the more you get.

What should i do now?

Download the WordPress Sales Support Specialist Task Sheet (via the apply link), answer those questions, and then submit your application. It’s that simple!

The ability to write in clear English is essential in this role. We are unable to consider applications that fail to demonstrate a high level of written communication.

HIRING PROCESS
Our hiring process includes the task mentioned above, a 2nd task, and an interview with our management team, including a 3rd task. If a candidate successfully passes the interview stage, they will be offered a paid trial of 4-6 weeks before being offered a more permanent role.

Good luck!

Are you tech-oriented and love to work from home? Do you like coding and helping people? Then this is your chance […]
item.content:encoded:
As part of Incsub, since 2006, WPMU DEV, with its’ award-winning WordPress plugins, hosting, world-beating support and site management tools, has helped millions of web developers, freelancers and agencies run and grow their businesses.

Are you tech-oriented and love to work from home? Do you like coding and helping people?

Then this is your chance to make a difference. Stop dreaming about tomorrow; join our team at WPMU DEV and let it be the biggest change in your growth today.

Our talented, inspirational team is located globally, with team members working from every continent. Location is unimportant as long as you are available and enthusiastic. Our team members work in shifts, and we aim to provide 24/7 coverage to our customers.

We’re looking for a person that will be able to also work on weekends and be available to work on the following schedules:

  • 4:00 pm – 12:00 am UTC

Responsibilities

At WPMU DEV, we power and host websites used by millions of users every single day. We’re looking for experienced WordPress Support Specialists who can join our team in our quest to offer the best support in the WordPress ecosystem. You’d need to be polite, patient and understanding with our customers.

The role involves:

  • Supporting our awesome members and customers
  • Responding to customers who report issues with their website(s), plugins or hosting services and handling/debugging issues (promptly)
  • Hanging out in the WordPress.org forums – being massively friendly, helpful, and useful
  • Helping customers with their WordPress problems by logging into their websites, diagnosing issues and offering solutions.
  • Writing clear and helpful responses to customer queries via email, chat and our forum.
  • Providing knowledgeable recommendations for solutions to handle customer feature requests.
  • Providing our developers and Second Level Support Team with clear and detailed bug reports for escalation.
  • Properly document & summarize tests or troubleshooting steps for communicating both with customers and colleagues.
  • Assisting with and solving all manner of WordPress questions with style!
  • Being an active part of the Incsub team.

Reach for the skies; we have many challenges and opportunities for those who aspire to do more!

Qualifications

Essential attributes and experience required:

  • At least 2+ years of experience with WordPress.
  • Ability to code using PHP, CSS, MySQL and HTML.
  • Good knowledge of the WordPress platform and WordPress hooks & filters
  • Ability to diagnose WordPress issues by isolating potential factors and providing resolution
  • An understanding of browser console errors and debugging via developer tools
  • Attention to detail and aptitude for problem-solving
  • Great interpersonal communication skills, being kind, supportive, and all-around friendly
  • Being a great team player, keen on working in an expanding, motivated, distributed support team
  • Love for impressive response times, typing speed (it matters), and the ability to produce quality work between deadlines
  • Fluent in English to communicate effectively.
  • Ability to work full-time (40 hours/week)

SKILL-SET
WordPress, Technical Support, Customer Support, Communication, PHP, CSS, MySQL, HTML

Job benefits

Why Join us?

  • Growth-oriented culture.
  • Excellent compensation with competitive benefits and rejuvenation time-off.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Training, tools and support will be provided to help you to perform your job.
  • Limitless learning opportunities by working with cutting-edge tech stacks and a diverse, talented team.
  • 28 days of paid leave per annum (up to 35 days).
  • Opportunities for paid travel to attend WordCamps and other industry conferences.
  • Long service leaves (3 months off paid) after you’ve been with us for 10 years.
  • Annual bonus based on company growth targets
  • Technology budget that can help you upgrade the tools you use for your job; the longer you serve, the higher the budget.
  • General expenses budget yearly that can be used to help you become more productive; the longer you work, the more you get.

What should I do now?

If you would like to be part of our company and feel your values match ours, submit your application along with a copy of your CV and the completed WordPress Support Specialist Task, and we’ll get in touch. It’s that simple!

HIRING PROCESS

Our hiring process includes the attached task (found via the apply link) and an interview with our management team, enclosing a 2nd task. If a candidate successfully passes the interview stage, they will be offered a paid trial of 4-6 weeks before being offered a more permanent role.

Good luck!

* Applications must include the completed task sheet (found via the apply link) to be assessed

item.content:encoded:
We are seeking a capable WordPress developer for a short-term, paid website development project.

The client is a privately held Canadian management consulting startup.

The project involves developing approximately six pages from completed design storyboards, supplied branding and approved website content.

The mandatory platform is WordPress using the Gutenberg block editor, Kadence Theme and Kadence Blocks.

We are particularly interested in a student, recent graduate or junior freelancer who has already completed professional-quality WordPress websites.

Our anticipated budget is C$2,000–$2,500 on a fixed-price basis, with an immediate start preferred.

The work can be performed remotely.

We would appreciate receiving examples of relevant completed websites, confirmation of experience with Kadence, and an indication of availability.

The client’s identity and detailed project materials will be provided to shortlisted candidates under appropriate confidentiality arrangements.

If you are interested, or can recommend a suitable developer, we would welcome hearing from you.

Thank you.
